correctness.rationale: The two polynomial identities are derived independently from Jacobi orthogonality; the first uses a zero at the right endpoint and the second uses integration by parts with vanishing boundary terms for beta>-1. Their difference-of-squares yields an exact primitive with zero left endpoint, fixing the normalization and proving the identity for every real beta>-1 and integer k>=1. The k-1 interior zeros are simple by standard Jacobi orthogonality, so contacts have multiplicity exactly two. Exact symbolic and independent quadrature checks passed for 96 finite instances; no finite experiment is presented as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A fixed-degree disk wavefront represented in an orthogonal Zernike basis has no evident pointwise radial-energy ranking: each polynomial oscillates. The exact squared-Jacobi identity proves a uniform stochastic ordering for every truncated centered pupil, establishes exactly k-1 interior contact radii of double multiplicity, and transfers across dimensions. This structural all-parameter theorem can inform aperture-mode concentration analysis and identifies the full adjacent-mode degeneracy geometry; it is not a narrow parameter slice or an unmotivated table.
